_comment: Finding statuses an organization may put behind a second person.
Restricted to the statuses that end the obligation, because those are what
accepting a risk means. Gating the working states (new, analyzing) would
stop triage rather than stop a decision.
Three places read this vocabulary: the backend validator that rejects an
unknown name, the frontend list that draws the checkboxes, and this file.
A name offered by the editor but rejected by the API fails only on save,
after the user has done the work; a name accepted by the API but missing
from the editor is a control nobody can find. Both sides assert against
this file so neither drifts alone.
Order is asserted: the frontend renders the checkboxes in this order, from
the least severe outcome to the most.
